Bash(cd /Users/liuxingwang/ziniao-scripts && ./dev.sh &
DEV_PID=$!
echo "dev.sh PID: $DEV_PID"
sleep 5
echo "--- 检查端口 ---"
lsof -i :9482 2>/dev/null | grep LISTEN || echo "后端未监听"
lsof -i :5173 2>/dev/null | grep LISTEN || echo "前端未监听"
echo "--- 测试后端 API ---"
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:9482/api/flows 2>/dev/null | head -c 200 || echo "后端请求失败"
echo
echo "--- 测试前端 ---"
curl -s http://localhost:5173 2>/dev/null | head -c 200 || echo "前端请求失败"
echo
echo "--- 停止 dev.sh ---"
kill $DEV_PID 2>/dev/null
sleep 2
# 清理子进程
kill $\(lsof -ti :9482 2>/dev/null\) 2>/dev/null || true
kill $\(lsof -ti :5173 2>/dev/null\) 2>/dev/null || true
echo "测试完毕")

Bash(cd /Users/liuxingwang/ziniao-scripts
# 第一轮：后台启动
./dev.sh &
PID1=$!
sleep 4
echo "=== 第一轮启动完毕，检查端口 ==="
lsof -i :9482 2>/dev/null | grep LISTEN | awk '{print "PID:", $2}'
lsof -i :5173 2>/dev/null | grep LISTEN | awk '{print "PID:", $2}'

# 第二轮：再启动一次，应自动杀掉第一轮
./dev.sh &
PID2=$!
sleep 4
echo "=== 第二轮启动完毕，检查端口 ==="
lsof -i :9482 2>/dev/null | grep LISTEN | awk '{print "PID:", $2}'
lsof -i :5173 2>/dev/null | grep LISTEN | awk '{print "PID:", $2}'

echo "=== 清理 ==="
kill $PID1 $PID2 2>/dev/null || true
sleep 1
kill $\(lsof -ti :9482 2>/dev/null\) 2>/dev/null || true
kill $\(lsof -ti :5173 2>/dev/null\) 2>/dev/null || true
echo "验证完毕")
